Latin word

paulisper

adverb · Wiktionary

for a moment, for a little while; for a short while, for a little while

In this lexicon

  • moment

    also used · classical · Plaut. As. 5.2.30: paulisper manē (Lewis & Short); Gell. 19.1.17: paulisper movērī; Traupman 87: wait a minute, manē paulisper

  • short

    also used · classical · Plaut. As. 5.2.30: paulisper manē (Lewis & Short s.v. paulisper); Cic. Verr. 2.4.39: abesse ā domō paulisper māluit (Lewis & Short s.v. ab)

Examples

  • Manē paulisper.

    Wait a moment.Traupman 87

    In the entry for moment

  • sapientis quoque animum paulisper movērī et contrahī et pallēscere necessum est

    even a wise man’s mind is bound to be shaken for a moment, to shrink and to turn paleGell. 19.1.17

    In the entry for moment
